data.narrative:
Reverion is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $79M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA) operating in similar frontier-technology energy and materials sectors, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape.

Two methods were applied to triangulate value. The stage-progression method uses the $79M total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation, then applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $150M. The peer-median method references three same-sector, same-stage comparables: KoBold Metals at $3.0B (Series C), Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B (Series C), and Amogy at $700M (Series C). The median across this peer group is $1.0B, with a range of $700M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $128M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $575M. The wide band reflects material uncertainty inherent to frontier-technology stage companies: peer comparables span nearly 5x ($700M to $3.0B), and stage-progression methodology may underestimate risk-adjusted value given capital intensity and execution risk in the climate-tech sector. Key sensitivities include near-term technical validation, capital deployment runway, and sector-wide funding dynamics.
